verses.decoded: Now these three remain: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love.

verses.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.decoded: Pursue love, and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.

verses.kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
verses.decoded: Anyone who speaks in a language unknown to others is not speaking to people but to God, because no one understands them; they are speaking spiritual secrets by the Spirit.

verses.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.decoded: But the one who prophesies speaks to people to build them up, encourage them, and comfort them.

verses.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.decoded: Anyone who speaks in an unknown language builds themselves up, but the one who prophesies builds up the whole church.

verses.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.decoded: I wish everyone could speak in tongues, but I would prefer you to prophesy because the one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues—unless the speaker explains what is said so the church can be strengthened.

verses.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will that help you unless I bring you a message of revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?

verses.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.decoded: Even instruments that don’t produce a living voice, like pipes or harps, must produce distinct sounds; otherwise, how will anyone know what tune is being played?

verses.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.decoded: If a trumpet sounds unclear, who will get ready for battle?

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
verses.decoded: In the same way, if you speak in a language that no one understands, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

verses.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
verses.decoded: There are many different languages in the world, and each one has meaning.

verses.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
verses.decoded: So if I don’t understand the language being spoken, I will seem like a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker will seem like a foreigner to me.

verses.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
verses.decoded: In the same way, since you are eager for spiritual gifts, try to excel in ways that build up the church.

verses.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.decoded: Therefore, anyone who speaks in an unknown language should pray to be able to interpret what they say.

verses.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.decoded: If I pray in an unknown language, my spirit is praying, but my mind doesn’t understand what I’m saying and so gains nothing.

verses.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.decoded: So what should I do? I will pray with my spirit and also pray with my mind; I will sing with my spirit and also sing with my mind.

verses.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
verses.decoded: If you bless with the Spirit, how can the person who doesn’t understand what you’re saying say 'Amen' to your thanks?

verses.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.decoded: You give thanks well, but the other person is not helped or built up.

verses.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
verses.decoded: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

verses.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
verses.decoded: But in church, I would rather speak five understandable words to teach others than ten thousand words in a language no one understands.

verses.kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, don’t be immature in your thinking. Be innocent when it comes to evil, but mature in your understanding.

verses.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: The law says, 'I will speak to this people in other languages and lips,' but even then, they will not listen, says the Lord.

verses.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.decoded: Tongues are a sign for unbelievers, not believers; but prophecy is for believers, not unbelievers.

verses.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.decoded: If the whole church gathers and everyone speaks in tongues, outsiders or unbelievers will think you are crazy.

verses.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.decoded: But if everyone prophesies and an unbeliever or outsider comes in, they will be convinced and judged by what is said.

verses.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
verses.decoded: The secrets of his heart are revealed, and he will fall down and worship God, declaring that God is truly among you.

verses.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, when you gather, each of you may bring a song, a teaching, a tongue, a revelation, or an interpretation. Do everything to build others up.

verses.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
verses.decoded: If anyone speaks in tongues, let only two or three speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

verses.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.decoded: If there is no interpreter, the person should remain silent in church and speak only to themselves and God.

verses.kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.decoded: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others evaluate what is said.

verses.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.decoded: If someone else receives a revelation while the first is speaking, the first speaker should stop.

verses.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.decoded: You can all take turns speaking messages from God, so that everyone can learn and be encouraged.

verses.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.decoded: The prophets control their own spirits and do not lose control when they speak.

verses.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.decoded: God is not the source of confusion but of peace, just as it should be in all churches of believers.

verses.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
verses.decoded: Women should remain silent in church gatherings; they are not allowed to speak but should be submissive, as the law says.

verses.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.decoded: If women want to learn something, they should ask their husbands at home, because it is inappropriate for them to speak in church.

verses.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.decoded: Did God’s message come only from you, or was it given to you alone?

verses.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.decoded: If anyone considers themselves a prophet or spiritual person, they should recognize that what I am writing to you are the Lord’s commands.

verses.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.decoded: But if someone chooses to ignore this, let them remain ignorant.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.decoded: Therefore, brothers and sisters, desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

verses.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.decoded: Everything should be done properly and in an orderly way.

verses.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I want to remind you of the good news I preached to you, which you accepted and by which you are now living.

verses.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
verses.decoded: You are saved through this gospel if you continue to hold firmly to the message I preached to you, unless your faith was useless.

verses.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.decoded: First of all, I passed on to you what I also received: that Christ died for our sins as the Scriptures said he would.

verses.kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.decoded: He was buried, and on the third day he rose again, just as the Scriptures predicted.

verses.kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.decoded: He appeared to Peter, then to the twelve apostles.

verses.kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.decoded: After that, he appeared to more than five hundred believers at the same time, most of whom are still alive, though some have died.

verses.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.decoded: Then he appeared to James, and later to all the apostles.

verses.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
verses.decoded: Finally, he appeared to me as well, though I came into the picture later than the others.

verses.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.decoded: I am the least of all the apostles because I persecuted God’s church and am not worthy to be called an apostle.

verses.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.decoded: But God’s grace made me who I am, and his grace was not wasted on me. I worked harder than all the others, but it was really God’s grace working through me.

verses.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.decoded: So whether it was me or the others preaching, this is the message you believed.

verses.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.decoded: Since people are preaching that Christ rose from the dead, how can some of you say there is no resurrection of the dead at all?

verses.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
verses.decoded: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ himself has not been raised.

verses.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
verses.decoded: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is useless and your faith is pointless.

verses.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.decoded: In fact, if the dead are not raised, then we are lying witnesses about God because we said he raised Christ, but he did not.

verses.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
verses.decoded: If the dead do not rise, then Christ has not been raised either.

verses.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.decoded: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is useless and you are still trapped in your sins.

verses.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
verses.decoded: If Christ is not raised, then those who have died believing in Him are lost.

verses.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
verses.decoded: If our hope in Christ is only for this life, then we are the most unfortunate people.

verses.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.decoded: But now Christ has been raised from the dead and is the first to rise among those who have died.

verses.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.decoded: Because death came through a man, resurrection from the dead also comes through a man.

verses.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.decoded: Just as everyone dies because of Adam, everyone will be made alive because of Christ.

verses.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
verses.decoded: But each person will be raised in their proper order: Christ first, then those who belong to Him when He returns.

verses.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.decoded: Then the end will come, when Christ hands over the kingdom to God the Father after destroying all rulers, authorities, and powers.

verses.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.decoded: Christ must reign until He has put all His enemies under His control.

verses.kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.decoded: The last enemy to be destroyed is death itself.

verses.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith, all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.decoded: God has put everything under Christ’s authority. But when it says 'all things are under Him,' it’s clear that God, who gave Him this authority, is not included.

verses.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.decoded: When everything is under Christ’s control, He will also submit to God the Father, so that God will be supreme over everything.

verses.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.decoded: If the dead are not raised, why do some people get baptized on behalf of those who have died?

verses.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.decoded: And why do we face danger every hour if there is no resurrection?

verses.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.decoded: I solemnly declare, because of the joy I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I face death every day.

verses.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
verses.decoded: If, like any human, I fought wild animals in Ephesus, what benefit is it to me if the dead are not raised? Then let’s just eat and drink, because tomorrow we die.

verses.kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.decoded: Don’t be fooled: bad company ruins good character.

verses.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
verses.decoded: Wake up to live rightly and stop sinning; some of you don’t know God, and I say this to shame you.

verses.kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.decoded: Someone might ask, ‘How are the dead raised? What kind of body will they have?’

verses.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.decoded: You fool! What you plant doesn’t come to life unless it first dies.

verses.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
verses.decoded: When you plant, you don’t plant the actual body that will grow, but just a seed—maybe wheat or some other grain.

verses.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.decoded: But God gives it the body He wants, and each seed gets its own kind of body.

verses.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
verses.decoded: Not all flesh is the same: humans have one kind, animals another, fish another, and birds another.

verses.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.decoded: There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, and the glory of the heavenly is different from the earthly.

verses.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.decoded: The sun has one kind of glory, the moon another, and the stars another; each star shines differently.

verses.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.decoded: The resurrection of the dead is like this: the body is buried in decay but raised in imperishability.

verses.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.decoded: It is buried in shame but raised in honor; buried weak, but raised strong.

verses.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.decoded: We plant a natural body, but it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and a spiritual body.

verses.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
verses.decoded: As it is written, the first man Adam became a living being; the last Adam (Christ) became a life-giving spirit.

verses.kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.decoded: But the natural body comes first, then the spiritual body comes later.

verses.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.decoded: The first man was made from the earth and is earthly; the second man is the Lord who came from heaven.

verses.kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.decoded: Those who belong to the earth are like the earthly man, and those who belong to heaven are like the heavenly man.

verses.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.decoded: Just as we have been made to look like the earthly man, we will also be made to look like the heavenly man.

verses.kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.decoded: I tell you this, brothers and sisters: our physical bodies cannot inherit God's kingdom, and what is perishable cannot become imperishable.

verses.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.decoded: Listen, I will tell you a secret: not all of us will die, but all of us will be transformed.

verses.kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.decoded: In an instant, in the blink of an eye, at the last trumpet call, the dead will be raised with imperishable bodies, and we will be changed.

verses.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.decoded: Our perishable bodies must be clothed with something imperishable, and our mortal bodies must be clothed with immortality.

verses.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.decoded: When our perishable bodies become imperishable and mortal bodies become immortal, the prophecy will come true: Death has been defeated.

verses.kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
verses.decoded: Death, where is your power to hurt? Grave, where is your victory?

verses.kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.decoded: The reason death hurts is because of sin, and sin’s power comes from the law.

verses.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: But thank God! He gives us victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.decoded: So, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm and steady. Always do your best in the Lord’s work, because you know your efforts are not useless.

verses.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
verses.decoded: Now about the collection for the believers in need, just as I instructed the churches in Galatia, you should do the same.

verses.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.decoded: On the first day of each week, each of you should set aside some money in saving, according to how God has blessed you, so that there won’t be any collections when I arrive.

verses.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: When I come, I will send those you approve in writing to take your generous gift to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.decoded: If it seems right for me to go as well, those people will travel with me.

verses.kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.decoded: I will come to you when I pass through Macedonia, because I am definitely going through Macedonia.

verses.kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.decoded: I might stay with you for a while, even through the winter, so you can help me on my journey wherever I go next.

verses.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.decoded: I won’t just pass by and see you briefly; I hope to stay with you for some time, if the Lord allows.

verses.kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.decoded: But for now, I will stay in Ephesus until the day of Pentecost.

verses.kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.decoded: A great and effective opportunity has opened up for me, but there are many opponents.

verses.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.decoded: When Timothy arrives, make sure he feels welcome and unafraid, because he serves the Lord just as I do.

verses.kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.decoded: Don’t treat him with disrespect; instead, send him off in peace so he can come to me, because I am expecting him along with the others.

verses.kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.decoded: About our brother Apollos, I really wanted him to visit you with the others, but he didn’t want to come right now. He will come when the time is right.

verses.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.decoded: Stay alert, stand firm in your faith, act courageously, and be strong.

verses.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.decoded: Let everything you do be done with love.

verses.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, you know that the household of Stephanas was the first to believe in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to serving the believers.

verses.kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
verses.decoded: Be willing to submit to those leaders and to everyone who works with us and puts in effort.

verses.kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.decoded: I am happy that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come because they have filled in for what you were missing.

verses.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
verses.decoded: They have encouraged both me and you, so you should recognize and respect people like them.

verses.kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.decoded: The churches in Asia send their greetings to you. Aquila and Priscilla also send many greetings in the Lord, along with the church that meets in their home.

verses.kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
verses.decoded: All the brothers and sisters send their greetings. Greet each other with a holy kiss.

verses.kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
verses.decoded: This is Paul’s own handwritten greeting.

verses.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.
verses.decoded: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, may they be cursed—our Lord is coming.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.decoded: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

verses.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.decoded: My love is with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen. (This letter to the Corinthians was sent from Philippi by Stephanas, Fortunatus, Achaicus, and Timothy.)
